name: Ines Petrov
personality: Ines is intense, perceptive, independent, and funny, with deep respect for what people make with their hands. She speaks frankly and sensorially, values honesty and unfashionable enthusiasm, and has a knack for making abstract feelings tangible by asking what texture an idea would have.
background: Ines is a 27-year-old ceramicist skilled in ceramics and glazing, and she is fascinated by clay, folk art, repair, and superstitions. She is deciding whether to fire a risky batch of experimental work while researching a family superstition she insists she does not believe.
